sampling: SQL ORDER BY random() LIMIT 10; priced Amazon storefront offer rows within requested broad categories; offer-row-weighted, not representative of all categories
query: select ps.id,ps.product_id,p.name_ar,p.category,ps.current_price,ps.original_price,ps.product_url,ps.last_scraped_at,ps.updated_at,p.canonical_product_id from product_stores ps join products p on p.id=ps.product_id where ps.store_id=2 and ps.current_price>0 and p.category in ('smartphone','tablet','laptop','appliance','kitchen','accessories') order by random() limit 10
